knowledge:
- key_parameters: maxInputsPerGate=Specifies the maximum number of inputs allowed when expanding logic gates (default is 2, can be set to 3 or 4) ;; sizeFac=Penalizes larger model sizes in the objective function (default is 1e-04) ;; NAFac=Penalizes unresolved states/NAs in the simulation output (default is 1) ;; popSize=Population size for the genetic algorithm (default is 50) ;; maxTime=Maximum optimization time in seconds ;; maxGens=Maximum number of generations for the genetic algorithm ;; stallGenMax=Maximum number of stall generations before stopping optimization ;; relTol=Relative tolerance on the score to identify sub-optimal but close models ;; numSolutions=Number of equivalent/near-optimal solutions to retrieve in ILP optimization ;; relGap=Tolerance gap for retrieving alternative ILP solutions ;; cplexPath=Path to the IBM-CPLEX executable required for ILP optimization ;; type=Resampling strategy for cross-validation ("datapoint", "experiment", or "observable") ;; nfolds=Number of folds for cross-validation
- alternatives: CNORdt=Use when ordinary differential equation-based logic modeling is preferred ;; CNORode=Use for ordinary equation-based continuous modeling ;; CNORProb=Use for probability-based logic modeling ;; ilpBinaryT1=An Integer Linear Programming alternative to the genetic algorithm (gaBinaryT1) that finds exact optimal and alternative sparse solutions using CPLEX
- when_to_use: Use when you have a prior knowledge network (PKN) of a signaling pathway and perturbation data (stimuli/inhibitors and downstream signal readouts) and want to construct a predictive, context-specific boolean logic model of the pathway.
- pitfalls: Species names in the SIF file must match the nodes in the data exactly and are case-sensitive ;; AND gates in the SIF file must be represented as dummy nodes named 'and' followed by a number (e.g., 'and1') ;; CNO only handles measurements on one cell line at a time ;; If data is not normalized between 0 and 1, you must run normaliseCNOlist first ;; Running ILP optimization (ilpBinaryT1) requires a valid IBM-CPLEX license and installation

workflows.name: single_time_point_ga
workflows.intent: Perform boolean logic network optimization for a single time-point dataset using a genetic algorithm.
input: ToyPKNMMB.sif (Prior Knowledge Network in Cytoscape SIF format)
ToyDataMMB.csv (Perturbation data in MIDAS CSV format)
workflows.stages: 1. Load perturbation data and convert to CNOlist ;; 2. Load prior knowledge network ;; 3. Check compatibility between data and network ;; 4. Preprocess the model (cut non-observable/non-controllable nodes, compress, and expand gates) ;; 5. Compute residual error ;; 6. Run genetic algorithm optimization ;; 7. Plot results and fit ;; 8. Map back optimized model to PKN ;; 9. Write results and generate HTML report
workflows.code:
dataToy <- readMIDAS("ToyDataMMB.csv", verbose=FALSE)
CNOlistToy <- makeCNOlist(dataToy, subfield=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
pknmodel<-readSIF("ToyPKNMMB.sif")
checkSignals(CNOlistToy,pknmodel)
model <- preprocessing(CNOlistToy, pknmodel, expansion=TRUE,
    compression=TRUE, cutNONC=TRUE, verbose=FALSE)
resECNOlistToy <- residualError(CNOlistToy)
initBstring <- rep(1,length(model$reacID))
ToyT1opt <- gaBinaryT1(CNOlist=CNOlistToy, model=model,
    initBstring=initBstring, verbose=FALSE)
cutAndPlot(model=model, bStrings=list(ToyT1opt$bString),
    CNOlist=CNOlistToy,plotPDF=TRUE)
plotFit(optRes=ToyT1opt)
plotModel(model, CNOlistToy, bString=ToyT1opt$bString)
bs = mapBack(model, pknmodel, ToyT1opt$bString)
plotModel(pknmodel, CNOlistToy, bs, compressed=model$speciesCompressed)
writeScaffold(
    modelComprExpanded=model,
    optimResT1=ToyT1opt,
    optimResT2=NA,
    modelOriginal=pknmodel,
    CNOlist=CNOlistToy)

writeNetwork(
    modelOriginal=pknmodel,
    modelComprExpanded=model,
    optimResT1=ToyT1opt,
    optimResT2=NA,
    CNOlist=CNOlistToy)

namesFilesToy<-list(
    dataPlot="ToyModelGraph.pdf",
    evolFitT1="evolFitToyT1.pdf",
    evolFitT2=NA,
    simResultsT1="SimResultsT1_1.pdf",
    simResultsT2=NA,
    scaffold="Scaffold.sif",
    scaffoldDot="Scaffold.dot",
    tscaffold="TimesScaffold.EA",
    wscaffold="weightsScaffold.EA",
    PKN="PKN.sif",
    PKNdot="PKN.dot",
    wPKN="TimesPKN.EA",
    nPKN="nodesPKN.NA")

writeReport(
    modelOriginal=pknmodel,
    modelOpt=model,
    optimResT1=ToyT1opt,
    optimResT2=NA,
    CNOlist=CNOlistToy,
    directory="testToy",
    namesFiles=namesFilesToy,
    namesData=list(CNOlist="Toy",model="ToyModel"))

workflows.name: two_time_point_ga
workflows.intent: Optimize a boolean logic model across two sequential time points to capture slow regulatory mechanisms like negative feedback.
workflows.stages: 1. Load two-time-point data and PKN ;; 2. Preprocess the model ;; 3. Optimize the first time point (T1) using gaBinaryT1 ;; 4. Plot T1 fit ;; 5. Optimize the second time point (TN) using gaBinaryTN, passing the T1 optimized bitstring ;; 6. Plot combined results for both time points
workflows.code:
data(CNOlistToy2,package="CellNOptR")
data(ToyModel2,package="CellNOptR")
pknmodel = ToyModel2
cnolist = CNOlist(CNOlistToy2)
plot(cnolist)
model = preprocessing(cnolist, pknmodel, verbose=FALSE)
T1opt <- gaBinaryT1(cnolist, model, stallGenMax=10, maxTime=60, verbose=FALSE)
sim <- cutAndPlot(model=model, bStrings=list(T1opt$bString),
    CNOlist=cnolist, plotPDF=TRUE)
plotFit(optRes=T1opt)
T2opt<-gaBinaryTN(cnolist, model,  bStrings=list(T1opt$bString),
    stallGenMax=10, maxTime=60, verbose=FALSE)
res <- cutAndPlot(
    model=model,
    bStrings=list(T1opt$bString, T2opt$bString),
    CNOlist=cnolist,
    plotPDF=TRUE, plotParams=list(cex=0.8, cmap_scale=0.5, margin=0.2))

workflows.name: ilp_optimization
workflows.intent: Train a PKN to perturbation data using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) to retrieve multiple alternative sparse optimal solutions.
workflows.stages: 1. Load data and PKN ;; 2. Preprocess the network ;; 3. Run ILP optimization using ilpBinaryT1 with a specified CPLEX path ;; 4. Plot and visualize the alternative optimized models and fits
workflows.code:
data("ToyModel", package="CellNOptR")
data("CNOlistToy", package="CellNOptR")
pknmodel = ToyModel
cnolist = CNOlist(CNOlistToy)
model = preprocessing(cnolist, pknmodel)
cplexPath = "path/to/cplex"
resILP = ilpBinaryT1(cnolist = cnolist, model = model,
                     numSolutions = 3, relGap = 0.05,
                     cplexPath = cplexPath)
cutAndPlot(CNOlist = cnolist, model = model, bStrings = list(resILP$bitstringILP[[1]]))
plotModel(model, cnolist, bString=resILP$bitstringILP[[1]])

cutAndPlot(CNOlist = cnolist, model = model, bStrings = list(resILP$bitstringILP[[2]]))
plotModel(model, cnolist, bString=resILP$bitstringILP[[2]])

cutAndPlot(CNOlist = cnolist, model = model, bStrings = list(resILP$bitstringILP[[3]]))
plotModel(model, cnolist, bString=resILP$bitstringILP[[3]])

workflows.name: cross_validation
workflows.intent: Assess the predictive performance of boolean models using k-fold cross-validation with parallel processing.
workflows.stages: 1. Load data and PKN ;; 2. Preprocess the network ;; 3. Subset timepoints in the CNOlist using cutCNOlist ;; 4. Perform k-fold cross-validation using crossvalidateBoolean with different resampling strategies in parallel or serial mode
workflows.code:
data(PKN_ToyPB, package="CellNOptR")
data(CNOlist_ToyPB, package="CellNOptR")
model = preprocessing(data = cnodata,model = pknmodel,compression = T,expansion = T)
plotModel(model,cnodata)
plot(cnodata)
selectedTime = c(0,10)
cnodata_prep = cutCNOlist(cnodata ,model = model,
                          cutTimeIndices = which(!cnodata@timepoints %in% selectedTime))
plot(cnodata_prep)
opt = gaBinaryT1(CNOlist = cnodata_prep,model = model)
library(doParallel)
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cores=3)
system.time({R1=crossvalidateBoolean(CNOlist = cnodata_prep, model = model,
                                     type="datapoint", nfolds=10, parallel = TRUE)})
system.time({R2=crossvalidateBoolean(CNOlist = cnodata_prep, model=model,
                                     type="experiment", nfolds=10, parallel = TRUE)})
system.time({R3=crossvalidateBoolean(CNOlist = cnodata_prep, model=model,
                                     type="observable", nfolds=10, parallel = TRUE)})
system.time({R4=crossvalidateBoolean(CNOlist = cnodata_prep, model=model,
                                     type="datapoint", nfolds=10, parallel = FALSE)})
system.time({R5=crossvalidateBoolean(CNOlist = cnodata_prep, model=model,
                                     type="experiment", nfolds=10, parallel = FALSE)})
system.time({R6=crossvalidateBoolean(CNOlist = cnodata_prep, model=model,
                                     type="observable", nfolds=10, parallel = FALSE)})
